headline: Brand and Visual Designer
tagline: Brand designer experienced in building cohesive visual identities, scalable design systems, and multi-medium marketing assets for startups and enterprises.

skills.label: Design Tools
skills.items: Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, Framer, Webflow, Miro, Notion

skills.label: Brand & Visual Design
skills.items: Brand Identity Creation, Visual Systems, Typography, Color Systems, Layout, Brand Guidelines, Print Production

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives supporting employee engagement, branding, recruitment, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work across internal and external materials.
Collaborated directly with HR and management stakeholders to deliver assets with low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready file requirements including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy for marketing collateral.
Applied typography, colour systems, and layout hierarchies to ensure consistency across digital and print mediums.

experience.title: UI/UX and Brand Designer
bullets: Developed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses and startups.
Designed social campaigns and marketing brochures for SMB clients, establishing foundational brand assets.
Conducted usability testing and translated findings into user flows and interface usability improvements.
Created wireframes and prototypes for digital products using Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.
Partnered with developers and stakeholders to ensure design-to-development handoff integrity.

projects.name: AT Creation Startup Branding Kit
bullets: Created a complete branding kit including logo design, typography selection, and color palettes for an early-stage startup.

projects.name: Fashion Brand Social Campaign
bullets: Designed an Instagram and Facebook campaign series that contributed to a 15% increase in follower engagement.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her brand identity and visual systems experience at Ascent Business Solutions and AT Creation to directly match Mindrift's need for a Brand Designer building foundational visual assets and enforcing brand consistency.
omitted: Bounceless UX case study - left out because this role specifically requires brand identity and visual design rather than B2B UX product design.
AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) - omitted to keep the focus strictly on core brand design execution as requested by the posting's emphasis on foundational design skills.
